facts.fact: Assigned vessel is USS Asteria, NCC-63542, Nebula-class.
facts.subject: USS Asteria

facts.fact: Assigned quarters are Deck 7, Section 12, cabin 0712-C.
facts.subject: Quarters

facts.fact: Ship orientation is scheduled for 1400 hours.
facts.subject: Orientation

facts.fact: Report to department head at 1530 hours.
facts.subject: Department

facts.fact: Chief Lian Okafor is the transporter chief who welcomed Jeremy aboard in Transporter Room 2.
facts.subject: Lian Okafor

facts.fact: Brel Joras is a Bolian crewman assigned to transporter systems; he said this is his first posting here.
facts.subject: Brel Joras

facts.fact: Brel said he completed transporter training on Earth and travelled to Starbase 375 before joining Asteria.
facts.subject: Brel Joras

facts.fact: Jeremy has settled into quarters 0712-C. The cabin has a bed, desk terminal, storage and a window with a view into space.
facts.subject: Quarters 0712-C
